    <item>
      <title>Anthropic S-1 Reveals Rapid Growth Ahead of Blockbuster IPO</title>
      <link>https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/26/technology/anthropic-ipo-finances.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="true">https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/26/technology/anthropic-ipo-finances.html</guid>
      <atom:link href="https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/26/technology/anthropic-ipo-finances.html" rel="standout"></atom:link>
      <description>Ahead of what could be the largest public listing ever, Anthropic said revenue soared to $16.3 billion in the first half of the year, and it planned to spend $807 billion on A.I. infrastructure.</description>
      <dc:creator>Mike Isaac, Erin Griffith, Lauren Hirsch and Sri Muppidi</dc:creator>
      <pubDate>Mon, 26 Oct 2026 18:08:07 +0000</pubDate>
      <category domain="http://www.nytimes.com/namespaces/keywords/des">Artificial Intelligence</category>

      <category domain="http://www.nytimes.com/namespaces/keywords/nyt_per">Amodei, Dario</category>
      <media:content height="1801" medium="image" url="https://static01.nyt.com/images/2026/08/20/multimedia/00biz-anthropic-finances-hfo-2-mjwl/00biz-anthropic-finances-hfo-2-mjwl-mediumSquareAt3X.jpg" width="1800"></media:content>
      <media:credit>Jason Henry for The New York Times</media:credit>
      <media:description>Anthropic, a powerhouse in A.I., is only five years old and seemingly came out of nowhere.</media:description>
    </item><item>
      <title>The Key Numbers From Anthropic’s IPO Filing</title>
      <link>https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/26/technology/anthropic-business-key-numbers.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="true">https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/26/technology/anthropic-business-key-numbers.html</guid>
      <atom:link href="https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/26/technology/anthropic-business-key-numbers.html" rel="standout"></atom:link>
      <description>We broke down the A.I. company’s key figures, which give insight into the health of its business, its future plans and who’s in charge.</description>
      <dc:creator>Sri Muppidi and Lauren Hirsch</dc:creator>
      <pubDate>Mon, 26 Oct 2026 20:21:29 +0000</pubDate>
      <category domain="http://www.nytimes.com/namespaces/keywords/des">Artificial Intelligence</category>

      <category domain="http://www.nytimes.com/namespaces/keywords/nyt_per">Amodei, Dario</category>
      <media:content height="1800" medium="image" url="https://static01.nyt.com/images/2026/10/26/multimedia/26biz-anthropic-numbers-vztf/26biz-anthropic-numbers-vztf-mediumSquareAt3X.jpg" width="1800"></media:content>
      <media:credit>Jason Henry for The New York Times</media:credit>
      <media:description>Anthropic’s Code W/ Claude event in San Francisco in May. In a filing, the company provided rare insight into the business of a “frontier” A.I. lab that makes cutting-edge A.I. models.</media:description>
